column1: # Commits of the previous release line that an rc may cut WITHOUT, read by
# scripts/release/carry_forward_gate.py (rc_cut.sh step 0b). One row each, TAB-separated:
#   sha<TAB><7-40 hex prefix><TAB><reason, who ruled, when>
#   subject<TAB><python regex on the subject><TAB><reason, who ruled, when>
# A row is a ruling that the change is not wanted on the new line, or is already there
# in a rewritten form the content check cannot see. It is never a way to make the gate green.

column3: version bumps belong to their own release line; car bumps itself (aprender-e6, 2026-09-26)
